chunks: And from him, from Hammad, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"What is prohibited due to kinship (blood relation) is also prohibited due to breastfeeding."
ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between blood kinship and breastfeeding in determining marriage prohibitions in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* articulates the principle of *ittihad al-hukm* (unity of ruling) between blood kinship (*qarabah*) and nursing kinship (*radha'*), establishing that the degrees of prohibition are identical. In Shia jurisprudence, this serves as the foundational textual evidence for treating *muharramat al-radha'* with the same legal weight as *muharramat al-nasab*, ensuring consistency in marriage eligibility across both lineages. It underscores the permanence of these prohibitions, mirroring the eternal nature of blood ties.
